producer_report.summary: Design producers now get an \"Existing code to read before you design\" section in their brief, written only when the reading's class_of_work is design. Root cause: the reader already requires an `Existing code:` list, but the producer saw it only as one Assumptions line. The brief never told the producer to open it, to search the repository for what it omits, or to name the code behind each claim. The section quotes the listed assumptions, or says none is listed. It tells the producer to open the paths and search for each further component, cache, config or limit. It also asks for an \"Existing code\" section in the doc that names each reused or extended path and says whether each proposed component exists. Finally, it asks for the file and function behind each claim and the source of each number. `AcceptedReading` gained `class_of_work`, and the planner Report gets a design-only rule. No refusal rule was added. I ran the athena-context, drift, policy, mirrors, ontology and budgets tests plus fmt and clippy, and all passed. I did not run the full `cargo test --locked`.

checks_run.note: 150 passed, including the four new tests

checks_run.command: cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors; cargo test -p athena-cli --test ontology --test budgets

criteria_check.criterion: Root cause named in the doc comment of the new section function in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs: a design producer was never given the inventory of existing code that the reader already requires, and nothing compared the doc's components with the repository.
criteria_check.evidence: Doc comment above existing_code_section names it: the producer was never told to use the inventory the reader requires (check_design_existing_code), it arrives as one Assumptions line, and nothing compared the doc's components with the repository. I corrected the cause to match what the code shows: the list is already in the brief as an assumption, so the gap is the missing instruction and search. Same text is in CHANGELOG.md and D183. Read in the diff.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs adds a producer-brief section, written only when the reading's class_of_work is design, that quotes each `Existing code:` assumption of the reading. It tells the producer to open those paths, to put an "Existing code" section in the doc that names each reused or extended path, and to state for each component the design proposes whether it exists in the repository. It also says to check any cache, config or limit the design depends on against the repository.
criteria_check.evidence: existing_code_section returns early unless class_of_work == "design"; it quotes each Existing code: assumption, then four bullets covering open paths, search, Existing code section with reuse or extend and whether each component exists, and cache, config or limit check. Asserted in the_design_producer_brief_has_the_existing_code_section (cargo test -p athena-context, passes).

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test -p athena-context: a new unit test builds producer_brief for a design reading with an `Existing code:` assumption naming crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs. It asserts the brief contains that path, the heading Existing code and the instruction to reuse or extend. The test fails on the base commit and passes with the change.
criteria_check.evidence: the_design_producer_brief_has_the_existing_code_section passes. It slices the brief after the new heading, which does not exist on base, so the expect panics there. It asserts the jev.rs path, 'Existing code' and 'reuse or extend' in the slice.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test -p athena-context: a new unit test builds producer_brief for a code reading and for a docs reading and asserts the new section is absent, so other classes' briefs are unchanged. Existing brief tests still pass.
criteria_check.evidence: other_classes_producer_briefs_have_no_existing_code_section covers code, tests, docs, prompts, config, build and other, and checks that the design brief minus its section equals the code brief. The full run of cargo test -p athena-context passed 150 of 150.

criteria_check.criterion: The recorded fmt, clippy and test checks pass on the final tree (cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy, cargo test).

learnings: The producer brief already printed the Existing code assumption through reading_sections; the gap is the missing instruction, not the missing list.
The Bash hook allows only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm; cd, tail, grep and wc are refused.
